blocks.html: The Jaguar Ingenium 2.0 diesel (AJ200D / 204DTD) is a complex engine with the timing chain assembly mounted at the rear, on the flywheel side[reference:0]. We carry out timing chain and injector seal replacement to factory specification, with full strip-down access, component inspection, and reassembly.

We begin by gaining access to the timing chain area. Depending on the vehicle's layout, this means either dropping the entire engine and gearbox assembly (transverse installations) or removing the transmission (longitudinal setups)[reference:1]. Once access is secured, we remove the upper and lower timing chains, guides, tensioners, and sprockets, then install a complete timing chain kit with revised components[reference:2][reference:3].

For injector seal replacement, we remove the high-pressure fuel pipes, wiring loom tray, and injector clamps to access each injector. We clean the injector seat, replace the copper seal and clamp bolt, and reassemble with new stretch bolts[reference:4][reference:5]. We cap fuel ports and handle injectors with care to avoid damage to the nozzle tips[reference:6].

blocks.html: The Ingenium 2.0 diesel (AJ200D / 204DTD) was fitted across the Jaguar range from 2015 onwards[reference:7]. We carry out timing chain and injector seal repairs on the following models:

steps.title: Vehicle arrival & initial inspection
steps.body: We visually inspect the engine bay and ancillaries, then prepare the vehicle for timing chain access.

steps.title: Engine / gearbox drop (as required)
steps.body: For transverse engines, we drop the entire engine and gearbox assembly; for longitudinal, we remove the transmission[reference:8].

steps.title: Timing chain removal
steps.body: We lock the engine in the timed position using JLR-specific timing tools, then remove the upper and lower chains, guides, tensioners, and sprockets[reference:9].

steps.title: Component inspection & parts replacement
steps.body: We inspect the crankshaft, camshafts, and oil pump. We install a complete timing chain kit with new chains, guides, tensioners, and sprockets[reference:10][reference:11].

steps.title: Injector seal replacement
steps.body: We remove the wiring loom tray, high-pressure pipes, and injector clamps. We clean the injector seat, replace the copper seal and stretch bolt, and reassemble[reference:12][reference:13].

steps.title: Reassembly, timing check & road test
steps.body: We reassemble the engine, reinstall the engine/gearbox assembly, check timing with diagnostic tools, and road-test the vehicle before handover.
